list.title: {n} patients waiting for a next step
list.sub: Most urgent first. Open a patient to see the full file.
list.note: Files are read from the clinic system when opened and are not stored in iQlinic. Each view is recorded under your name.

pt.searchSub: Enter the file number. The file is read from the clinic system at that moment and is not stored in iQlinic.
pt.notFound: No patient with these details in the clinic system.
pt.unavailable: The file cannot be opened right now
pt.reading: Reading the file from the clinic system…
pt.privacy: This file was just read from the clinic system and is not stored in iQlinic. This view was recorded under your name.
pt.nextWhy: {n} days since the last session; usually done within {a} days.

out.no_answer: Recorded: no answer. They will be on the call list again tomorrow.
out.notOnList: This step is not on today's call list; record the outcome from the call list.

pt.noNextSub: Every treatment that needed a next visit is either completed or still within its usual time.
pt.teethSub: Click a tooth to see its history.
pt.teethAria: Tooth chart; {n} teeth have treatment history
pt.noTeeth: No tooth numbers were recorded for this patient, so there is no tooth chart.
pt.journeySub: Newest first. An episode is visits less than a year apart.

list.title: {n} active doctors
list.sub: Open a doctor to see their page. Numbers cover the last 12 months.

pf.unavailable: This page is not available right now
pf.notEnough: This doctor has too little activity in the last year for a page.
pf.footer: Built from the clinic's pseudonymous data for the last year. Service value is gross recorded value, not cash collected.

dir.title: Doctors
dir.sub: Open a doctor to see all of their work in one place. Doctors who have left are shown lighter.
dir.accountsSub: Accounts in the clinic system that are not a person (such as the clinic or reception account). Their work is shown separately.

k.newShare: First visit to the clinic was with this doctor; {p} of their patients

s.work: Treated {n} patients in the last 12 months, mostly {a}.
s.workPlain: Saw {n} patients in the last 12 months.
s.lossBetter: Their patients dropped out of treatment {p}% less than expected.
s.lossWorse: Their patients dropped out of treatment {p}% more than expected.
s.lossSame: Their patients drop out of treatment about as often as their case mix predicts.
s.missed: Their patients miss appointments ({a}) more than the clinic average ({b}).
s.booked: Their patients book the next step before leaving less often than the clinic ({a} vs {b}).

sec.clinicalSub: What they do, and where their treatments end up.
sec.timeSub: When they work, when it is busy, when they were not there.
sec.patientsSub: Who is waiting, and why some did not continue.

radar.title: Work signature
radar.aria: Share of each kind of treatment in this doctor's work, next to the clinic average
radar.note: Share of each kind of treatment they did. Imaging, exams, materials and payments are not counted.

out.title: Treatments that needed a next visit
out.steps: {n} treatment steps in the last 2 years

loss.title: Drop-out compared with expected
loss.expected: Expected for their kind of work

heat.title: Busy hours of the week
heat.aria: Average booked appointments per hour of the week
heat.tip: {d} at {h}:00: {n} appointments a week on average
heat.note: Each cell is the average number of appointments in that hour per week. Hover a cell to see its number.

off.title: Working days without visits
off.note: Days the clinic was open and this doctor usually worked, but had no visit and no booking. This is not leave; leave is not in our data.

wait.title: {n} patients waiting for the next step
wait.none: None of this doctor's patients are on today's call list.
wait.top: The {n} most urgent on the call list:

why.title: Why didn't they continue?
why.sub: From {n} follow-up calls with a recorded reason
why.none: No reasons recorded yet for this doctor's patients. They collect here when reception picks a reason after "called".

bars.note: The light last column is the current month, not finished yet.

money.title: Financial performance
money.note: Gross value of recorded services, not cash received. Part of the growth over last year is price increases.

pi.title: Imaging
pi.sub: This patient's OPGs, single-tooth X-rays and intraoral photos, read live from the clinic picture folder. Nothing is stored in iQlinic.
pi.locks: Each picture passed three checks: it is in this file number's folder, its file name has the clinic software's pattern, and this same patient was received at the clinic on the picture's date.
pi.noOpg: No OPG on file for this patient.
pi.loading: Reading pictures from the clinic folder…
pi.none: No pictures for this patient in the clinic picture folder.
pi.unavailable: The clinic picture folder is not reachable right now.
pi.failed: Pictures could not be read. Try again in a moment.
pi.ambiguous: Two picture folders match this file number. To avoid any mix-up no picture is shown. Please tell the system administrator.
pi.cut: This patient has a very large number of pictures; only part of them were read.

check.title: {n} pictures kept apart
check.sub: These pictures are in this patient's folder but did not pass one of the checks, so they are not in the gallery. Review them before use.
check.no_visit: No reception for this patient on the picture date
check.name: File name does not have the usual pattern

tooth.title: Pictures from this tooth's treatment days
tooth.none: No pictures were taken on this tooth's treatment days.
